# The bytes namespaceMayFollow accepts right before an Azure Resource Manager
# provider namespace (issue #610): one case per delimiter, shared by the two
# hand-written copies of the rule, so a copy that drops one fails a test of its
# own (issue #630).
#
# The rule is written twice: in the AI reviewer's host scan
# (ci/aireview/internal/review/scan.go) and in the fixture check
# (test/examples/fixtures_check_test.go), which cannot import the reviewer's
# library. Each copy's tests read this one list: scan_test.go by
# ../../../../test/examples/testdata/namespace_may_follow_delimiters.txt, and
# fixtures_hostrule_test.go by testdata/namespace_may_follow_delimiters.txt,
# both through their check, and fixtures_hostrule_test.go's
# TestNamespaceMayFollow also calls the fixture copy directly. A delimiter
# added to or dropped from one copy must be added to or dropped from this list
# and the other copy too.
#
# A record is a case name, ": " and the text the case runs. Every text holds a
# resource type whose provider namespace sits directly after the delimiter of
# its case (a real tab byte for the tab case, an empty text before it for the
# start of the text), so the namespace reads as a host name the moment a copy
# stops accepting that delimiter. A blank line and a line starting with "#" are
# no record.
#
# The fixture check reads a whole text, so a namespace that starts a line
# follows a newline there; a line of this file cannot carry one, so
# fixtures_hostrule_test.go pins that delimiter in a case of its own.
#
# This file sits under a testdata directory, so the fixture check reads it too:
# every namespace in it follows a delimiter the rule accepts, which is what
# keeps the file itself clean.
the start of the text: Microsoft.App/containerApps is the type
a double quote: "type": "Microsoft.App/containerApps"
an apostrophe: the type is 'Microsoft.App/containerApps' in the guide
a backtick: the type is `Microsoft.App/containerApps` in the guide
a space: the API returns Microsoft.App/containerApps for the app
a tab: the type is	Microsoft.App/containerApps in the export
an equals sign: type=Microsoft.App/containerApps
a vertical bar: |Microsoft.App/containerApps|
an opening parenthesis: list(Microsoft.App/containerApps)
an opening bracket: [Microsoft.App/containerApps]
a comma: resources: [app-a,Microsoft.App/containerApps]
a slash: /providers/Microsoft.App/containerApps
